objective: Generate paired physical-power scenarios from all 84 frozen final-EMA denoisers and adjudicate whether true-adjacency transition coordinates provide attributable dynamic utility without distribution damage.

role_access.evaluated_subset: the six cross-fitted chronological outer-test blocks within the 267 train days
role_access.outer_train_use: fit fold-specific mean replay, level/operator scales, atom nuisance, and pooled signed-ramp thresholds
role_access.outer_test_use: physical scenario metrics only after the complete 84-run training freeze
role_access.checkpoint_selection: none; every retained run has one fixed final EMA

sampling.common_random_group: one allocation/probability/epsilon identity per outer_fold and sampling_seed shared across seven paths and both model seeds
sampling.decode: outer-train fitted mean plus generated normalized latent residual, sigmoid, then exact sampled zero/interior/one states

ramp_thresholds.fit_scope: pooled signed physical-power ramps on each outer-train block only
ramp_thresholds.minimum_observation_rule: both adjacent target cells must be raw-observed

metrics.aggregation_order: average four sampling-seed metrics within model seed and day, then average the two model-seed metrics within day

late_horizon_missingness.source: target observed_mask only, before any model comparisons
late_horizon_missingness.rule: record NaN only when a calendar day has zero raw-observed target cells in the last six hours; store late_horizon_valid alongside all 17 metrics

inference.relative_contribution_denominator: the paired reference path full-sample mean fixed before resampling
inference.multiplicity_scope: all 28 primary, attribution, and safety endpoints in one joint family
inference.conservative_refinement: the two-sided joint band is at least as conservative as the directional one-sided language in the parent probe and permits a symmetric coverage gate

complete_case.rule: exclude the same target-mask-defined day from every one of the 28 paired inference endpoints

decision.candidate_primary_gate: TRANSITION_TRUE versus LEVEL_IID must meet both practical minima and both simultaneous lower bounds must exceed zero
decision.wrong_adjacency_gate: TRANSITION_TRUE versus TRANSITION_WRONG must have simultaneous lower bounds above zero on both primary metrics
decision.general_basis_gate: TRANSITION_TRUE versus ORTHOGONAL_DCT must be superior on at least one primary metric and noninferior on the other
decision.matched_both_gate: TRANSITION_TRUE versus LEVEL_MATCHED_BOTH must be superior on at least one primary metric and noninferior on the other
decision.safety_gate: all six jointly controlled safety limits must pass
decision.stability_gate: both primary point directions positive in at least five of six folds and in both model seeds
decision.SAMPLING_NO_GO_not_eligible: no reconstruction diagnostic is implemented in this evaluation, so that parent-protocol label cannot be assigned
decision.unexpected_sampling_only_signal: can authorize only a separately frozen confirmation and cannot support a reconstruction-mechanism claim

technical_hard_gates: all 336 archives and per-day metric artifacts exist with verified hashes
atom allocation, atom probabilities, and native epsilon hashes match exactly across every fold-sampling-seed common-random group
all decoded physical scenarios are finite and within [0,1]
sampled boundary atoms are exactly zero or one and every sampled interior remains strictly interior
any finite-logit FP64 sigmoid that rounds to 0 or 1 is encoded as the adjacent representable interior number; zero/one adjustments are counted in every archive; no larger post-hoc clipping is allowed
no held-out target atom state is passed to the sampler
calendar days and held-out arrays agree exactly across all paired archives
all archive scenario arrays retain FP64 dtype through write and read without implicit downcast
all 336 archives use fresh v1.3 sampling; no prior evaluation archive is reused
all 336 per-day metric artifacts have a late_horizon_valid bit; it is false only on 2013-12-31 and matches the target mask
the same 266 complete-case calendar days enter every one of the 28 jointly controlled endpoints

operational_contract.default_mode: target-free dry run that writes no file
operational_contract.first_operational_check: resample previously failing LEVEL_IID fold5 seed3 sampling61000 on CUDA; verify all 17 per-day metrics, late_horizon_valid false only for 2013-12-31, strict FP64 interior and sidecars; then execute the remaining 335 archives
operational_contract.code_or_config_change_after_first_archiv: forbidden; use a new versioned protocol and fresh output root

claim_boundary.authorized: an internally cross-fitted, mechanistically controlled statement about transition-object utility and attribution if every gate passes
not_authorized: automatic selection of Diffusion over Flow
a claim that differencing or invertible-coordinate diffusion was invented here

precision_revision.reason: v1.2 reached 280 complete archives; the next outer-held-out day (2013-12-31) has zero observed cells in the last six hours, making late-horizon level CRPS undefined although the day has 180 other observed cells and 170 valid adjacent ramps
precision_revision.scope: retain all 267 calendar days and all 336 scenario archives; mark that one late-horizon metric as unavailable; exclude that same day from all 28 paired inference endpoints, leaving 266 calendar days
